_comment: Feature-determinism baseline for tone.wav, captured from headless Chromium on 2026-07-21 (T10). The Analyzer is pure JS DSP (no GPU), so it is deterministic within an engine and near-identical across engines: the observed spread across chromium/firefox/webkit was < 2e-4 (only decodeAudioData differs slightly). Tolerances below are deliberately generous relative to that spread. Regenerate by logging analyzeFixture(tone) if the analysis pipeline intentionally changes.
